cases.title: Advection / sine translation
cases.assumptions: Periodic unit interval; constant advection speed 1.

cases.title: Burgers / shock
cases.assumptions: Entropy solution of a scalar whole-line Riemann problem; constant endpoint continuation.

cases.title: Burgers / rarefaction
cases.assumptions: Entropy solution of a scalar whole-line Riemann problem; constant endpoint continuation.

cases.title: Traffic / upstream shock
cases.assumptions: Entropy solution of a scalar whole-line Riemann problem; constant endpoint continuation.

cases.title: Traffic / clearing fan
cases.assumptions: Entropy solution of a scalar whole-line Riemann problem; constant endpoint continuation.

cases.title: Euler / Sod
cases.assumptions: Ideal gas; gamma>1; planar 1D waves; vacuum has zero conserved state and undefined velocity.

cases.title: Euler / Lax
cases.assumptions: Ideal gas; gamma>1; planar 1D waves; vacuum has zero conserved state and undefined velocity.

cases.title: Euler / double rarefaction
cases.assumptions: Ideal gas; gamma>1; planar 1D waves; vacuum has zero conserved state and undefined velocity.

cases.title: Euler / generated vacuum
cases.assumptions: Ideal gas; gamma>1; planar 1D waves; vacuum has zero conserved state and undefined velocity.

cases.title: Shallow water / wet dam break
cases.assumptions: Flat bottom; constant g; dry states allowed in the reference only, not the existing FV solver.

cases.title: Shallow water / dry-bed fan
cases.assumptions: Flat bottom; constant g; dry states allowed in the reference only, not the existing FV solver.

cases.title: Shallow water / dry middle state
cases.assumptions: Flat bottom; constant g; dry states allowed in the reference only, not the existing FV solver.

cases.title: Isothermal / density jump
cases.assumptions: p = c_s² rho; constant c_s; strictly positive initial density; no vacuum state or energy equation.

cases.title: Poisson / manufactured sine
cases.assumptions: Zero Dirichlet endpoints. The forcing is chosen from the target solution; this is not an arbitrary-source Poisson solution.

cases.title: Viscous channel / Couette
cases.assumptions: Fully developed planar steady channel; walls u(0)=0,u(1)=1; zero pressure gradient.

cases.title: Viscous channel / Poiseuille
cases.assumptions: Fully developed planar steady channel, no slip, unit density; −dp/dx=G or body acceleration G.

cases.title: Viscous flow / 2D Taylor–Green
cases.formula: (u,v)=(sin x cos y,−cos x sin y)e^(−2νt); p=(cos 2x+cos 2y)e^(−4νt)/4
cases.assumptions: Periodic [0,2π]²; unit density; viscosity 0.1; zero mean pressure. Web profile is an x-slice at y=π/4.

scope: Saved reference evaluations, not PDE simulations. Systems average conserved variables. Taylor–Green shows an x-slice at y=pi/4; no area means are displayed.

quadrature.convention: Gauss quadrature split at known fronts; 24/48 differences are convergence estimates, not rigorous error bounds.
